Godot import settings for an A3 asset
Godot import settings for an A3 asset
showcase controller: slots, slot yaw fix, lamp flicker, orbit camera
vertex-based measurement shared by the check and the self-test
scripted engine screenshots of the showcase (evidence/a3/godot-*.png)
headless check of the three .glb files against the brief
self-test: broken stand-ins the check must catch
machine-readable brief: sizes, budgets, colours, tolerances

components.explanation: The three A3 assets as exported glTF (+Y Up) from Blender 5.2.2: suv.glb (6 shapes, 456 tris), rock_shrine.glb (6 shapes, 266 tris), fence_segment.glb (6 shapes, 108 tris), each built by execute_blender_code bodies Claude ran through the Blender MCP (tools/blender/build_*.py, outside godot/), plus Godot's import settings.

The headless asset check: a3_brief.json holds sizes, budgets and colours; a3_measure.gd measures every mesh vertex in world space (floor from vertices, not a collider), triangles, shapes, scales, colours; check_a3_assets.gd compares the real .glb files with the brief (31 checks); check_a3_selftest.gd proves the check can fail on deliberately broken BoxMesh stand-ins (17 checks); capture_a3.gd takes the engine screenshots.

a3_showcase.tscn/.gd: the three assets in a row at game scale beside Hari's 1.75 m billboard, an orbit camera (behind and below), the shrine slot turned -90 degrees so the goddess faces the camera, and a flickering OmniLight3D for the lamp, because the model cannot animate.

excerpts.text:
var n := _fence(); n.position.y = 0.5                    # A3-F3: origin in the middle -> floats
	expect("floating by 0.5 m", await _result(n, spec, brief), "base on the floor", false)
	n = _fence(); n.scale = Vector3(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)           # A3-F2/F4: wrong size, unapplied scale
	var by := await _result(n, spec, brief)
	expect("scaled x0.1", by, "size within", false)
	expect("scaled x0.1", by, "every node scale", false)
	n = _fence(); n.rotation_degrees = Vector3(90, 0, 0)     # A3-F1: lying on its side
	by = await _result(n, spec, brief)
	expect("lying on its side", by, "upright", false)
	expect("lying on its side", by, "root not rotated", false)
	n = _fence()                                              # A3-F6: a colour lost in export
	((n.get_child(2) as MeshInstance3D).mesh.material as StandardMaterial3D).albedo_color = Color.WHITE
	expect("sign colour lost", await _result(n, spec, brief), "colour", false)
	var tight := spec.duplicate(true); tight.max_tris = 40    # A3-F5: over budget (4 boxes = 48 tris)
	expect("over the triangle budget", await _result(_fence(), tight, brief), "triangles", false)

## The shrine's goddess faces the asset's +X, which in this row pointed her at the SUV's tail 1.3 m away
## (seen in evidence/a3/godot-shrine-front.png, 2026-10-15). Turn her slot so she faces the camera side (+Z).
## The slot turns, not the asset: the asset's own transform stays identity, as the check requires.
const SLOT_YAW_DEG := {"rock_shrine": -90.0, "suv": 0.0, "fence_segment": 0.0}
